title: Guided Tour (with Audio) Hamilton Musical in Lower Manhattan NYC
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This immersive tour guided experience brings the songs and stories of Hamilton: The Musical to life as we explore the real locations that shaped the man and the legend. From "The Room Where It Happens" to the Rap Off between Hamilton and Jefferson to the gravesite at Trinity Church, explore "Who Lives, Who Dies, Who Tells Your Story", you'll see history unfold around you.

Your tour guide will correlate the music to the sites and give you all the real history lessons in the places where it all went down.

Come join the UNOFFICIAL Hamilton tour and may you always be satisfied!
